rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is incomplete or only partly known.

example.english: This report is still partial and is missing a few pages.
example.traditional: 呢份報告仲唔完整，仲差幾頁。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung6 m4 jyun4 zing2 zung6 caa1 gei2 jip6

rows.note: Use this when someone unfairly favors a particular person or side, especially in a dispute or competition.

example.english: Mum is always partial to my younger brother.
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 pin1 sam1 sai3 lou2

rows.note: Use this for an unfair decision, judgment, or treatment when the emphasis is on lack of fairness rather than personal favoritism.

example.english: This verdict is partial and unfair to him.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 pun3 kyut3 deoi3 keoi5 m4 gung1 dou6

rows.note: Use this everyday word when partial means fond of or liking something.

example.english: I’m partial to iced lemon tea.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jam2 dung3 ling4 caa4
